docs.abstract: The Biden administration has faced backlash from small-business owners who called the new I.R.S. reporting requirements confusing and onerous.

headline.main: Users of Venmo, Cash App and Other Digital Wallets Get a Tax Reprieve
headline.print_headline: Users of Etsy, PayPal, Venmo and Like Get Tax Reprieve, Again

multimedia.caption: The Internal Revenue Service is delaying enforcement of a contentious tax policy that would require users of digital wallets and e-commerce platforms to start reporting small transactions.
multimedia.credit: Julia Nikhinson for The New York Times
